description: This file defines the Vault class with methods for creating, clearing, deleting, unlocking, changing password, locking notes, and asking for passwords, managing vault-related operations in the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: A class providing static methods to manage vault operations such as creation, deletion, unlocking, locking, and password management within the Notesnook application.

methods.name: createVault
methods.description: Creates a new vault after checking if one exists, prompts for password, and shows success toast.

methods.name: clearVault
methods.description: Clears the vault after verifying its existence and prompting for password.

methods.name: deleteVault
methods.description: Deletes the vault after verifying its existence, prompting for password, and optional deletion of all locked notes.

methods.name: unlockVault
methods.description: Unlocks the vault by prompting for password.

methods.name: changeVaultPassword
methods.description: Changes the vault password after verifying old password and setting a new one.

methods.name: unlockNote
methods.description: Unlocks a specific note by ID after password verification.

methods.name: lockNote
methods.description: Locks a specific note by ID, handling errors such as no vault or vault locked.

methods.name: askPassword
methods.description: Generic method to prompt for a password and execute an action with it.

methods.name: lockVault
methods.description: Locks the vault and shows a success toast.
